utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh Gus, glad I ran into you — are you bringing anything to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, I'm bringing my old toolbox and a few spare lawnmower blades. Should be a good day helping folks out!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great, Gus! I'm planning on bringing my toaster that's been acting up — maybe someone there can work some magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right! I must've mixed up the day. Sunday at the community center—I'll be there with my lamp for sure!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Tess! And don't hesitate to bring that fan too—I'm sure we'll find a way to make it work!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I might just do that, Rosa! Though I'm starting to worry I'll show up with a whole pile of broken things and look like a hoarder!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, Mara, I think I'm as ready as I'll ever be. Just hoping I can be of some help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Uli, glad you're geared up for Saturday—do you have any spare screwdrivers or wrenches I could borrow for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Uh, I think I might have an old screwdriver somewhere. Let me check my shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, do you know what time we're supposed to drop off tools? I don't want to be late and mess up the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think Vik mentioned starting at 9 AM sharp, but let me double-check with him to be sure—wouldn't want you to miss anything!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, 9 AM sharp—got it. And do we have a list of what everyone's bringing? I don't want to haul my level over if someone else already has one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important with the repair drive plans?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, Dane, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead. You still in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, Sunday works for me. I'm in—what's the time again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I just need to double-check who's able to help out so I can sort out the school run for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday? That's the repair drive, right? Or is it Sunday? I always get those mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, it's Saturday morning—the water pump repair drive. Are you free to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bo, have you heard? Sam just told me the repair drive is this Saturday at 9, not next week. I need to rearrange my whole morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh really? Saturday at 9, got it. I'll have to ask a friend to cover my shift—thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it's a bit of a shake-up, but I'll adjust my schedule. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, so you haven't seen the repair drive fix the pump yourself? Because I'd rather not spread something that might just be hearsay.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, I haven't seen it yet—just heard chatter from a few folks. Could be true, but I'd check with someone who was actually there before passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, let's find Gus or someone who saw it firsthand before we say anything more.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, I'm glad you think so, but I'm still trying to track down where that repair drive ended up after Kira used it on the jack.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Opal, I've got a spare toolkit you can borrow if that helps track things down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's kind, Leo, but I think I need to pinpoint exactly where Kira put the drive last. Did you see her leave the community center with it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I’ve got those screwdrivers for the drive tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, that's perfect! Just bring them by anytime between 9 and noon—and I'd be happy to take a look at your fence after the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Quinn. I'll see you tomorrow morning then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to help out with fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm organizing it! Glad you're on board for the playground fix-up—that's one of our biggest projects.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, that's great you're organizing it! I've been telling everyone about it—the playground is really going to shine after this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive! I thought it was next weekend. Can you remind me of the details?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Oh, I haven't actually seen it yet—I keep mixing up the dates. Did it already happen?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, glad I caught you — are you still planning to bring that tool kit on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yeah, I've got an old toolkit I was thinking of dropping off. What time's good?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Saturday morning works best, say around 9. That way we can sort everything before folks start showing up for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, Vik's repair was amazing—it really got me thinking about what else we can fix up around here.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds great, Jules. I'll swing by if I can, but I'm really swamped today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally understand, Bo. No pressure—just glad you're thinking about it. Let me know if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, just not sure what I can offer.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, don't worry about that, Uli — even just an extra pair of hands makes such a difference, and you might be surprised what you can help with once you're there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I guess you're right, Rosa. I can at least carry things around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for checking with Eli and Pia—I'll hold off on finalizing the pickup list until I hear back from you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll let you know as soon as I hear from Eli and Pia—should be soon!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, just let me know—I want to make sure no one's stuck juggling both the drive and school runs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hold on, I thought we were dropping off tools at 9 AM—did someone change the time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, I remember 9 AM too, but let me double-check with Vik; he's usually the one who sets the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, can you please check? I just want to make sure we're all on the same page so I don't show up too early or too late.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Ira! I'm a bit fuzzy on the repair drive—do you know if it's Saturday or Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Nell, it's definitely Saturday! We're all meeting at the Andersons' place to fix up their car. Should be a good time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, at the Andersons'? I thought it was at the community center. Thanks for the clarification!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Tess! I was just talking to someone about that repair drive—did we settle on a time, or am I getting it all muddled again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Oren, good thing you asked! It's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I'm bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday, right, Sunday! So not Saturday then? I'll put it in my calendar... if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm glad to see you, Leo! Are you all set for the repair drive tomorrow? I've got extra tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I’ve got my tools ready too. See you at Rosa’s table tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I'll see you then! Rosa will have everything set up for a smooth start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to help out with fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The old playground? I thought the repair drive was for the community center. Are they doing both this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, I thought it was just the playground, but maybe they are doing both? Let me double-check with the organizers!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I'm glad you could make it! We've got quite a few folks signed up to help with the repair drive—I'll put you down for tool sorting if that works.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're saying the repair drive actually worked? Did you see it fix something yourself?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I saw Jerry's old toaster come back to life after Eli tinkered with it. It was pretty cool!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hello, Gus. I just heard the repair drive is this weekend, not next week. Do you have the schedule handy?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got it right here. It's Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I can adjust my calendar. Do we have a clear list of who's bringing what tools?
